name: Elite
long_description:
Elite builds AI voice agents that run the front office for healthcare practices. Elite answers every patient call instantly and finishes the job inside the practice's EHR: scheduling, triage, referrals, refills, eligibility, intake, and billing, across voice, SMS, and web, around the clock.

Front offices are drowning in phone volume, so patients wait on hold, calls go unanswered, and staff get pulled away from care. Elite picks up every call, resolves the routine ones end to end, and escalates anything complex to the team with full context. It ships knowing the scheduling protocols of 18 specialties and writes back to more than 19 EHRs including Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, and ModMed. There is no rip-and-replace, it goes live in days, and every resolved patient interaction is what we charge for.

Our starting point is healthcare. The mission is to rebuild the critical industries America runs on, including government, finance, insurance, and manufacturing, by deploying AI agents into the slow, manual workflows at their core.

launches.title: Stratum Industries - Applied AI for Governments
launches.tagline: AI agents that automate the complex manual workflows governments run on.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: Stratum builds AI agents that automate the slow, manual processes governments run on. We're starting with application review - clearing backlogs in a fraction of the time and saving agencies tens of billions a year.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108362&key=user_uploads/1648613/f70bb601-955f-4c6c-946f-8d8c90d04fa6)

**The problem**

Governments run on manual work. Millions of complex processes - reviews, approvals, filings, claims -are still handled by hand, one file at a time, on software built long before AI existed.

Take application review. Every permit, license, patent, drug approval, and benefits claim in America is reviewed by hand, one file at a time. Millions sit in queues while people wait months and years: veterans on disability ratings, families on pensions, builders on permits.

The tools reviewers open every morning were built long before AI. So the work stays manual, and the queue only grows.

This isn't one broken workflow. It's how the entire government runs.

**What Stratum does**

Stratum builds AI agents that automate the slow, complex, manual processes governments run on.

We're starting with application review.

A reviewer uploads an application and selects the rubric to check it against. From there, an agent takes over: it plans the review, works through the file end to end, and checks every requirement, routing each step to the right model.

A human approves every outcome, and every step is fully auditable.

The difference is scale. Instead of one reviewer on one file, hundreds of agents run in parallel — clearing an entire backlog in the time it once took to review a single application.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108362&key=user_uploads/1648613/e23f9409-271f-4879-95aa-374eb37ae64f)

**Who we are**

We're Vihaan (VJ) and Raj - brothers.

Vihaan (CTO): founding engineer #3 at Cadastral (acquired by Legora), waterloo dropout.

Raj (CEO): led GTM at Deel, dropped out of CS grad school at the University of Bath.

**Where this goes**

Application review is the first workflow. The mission is to integrate AI across every vertical inside the government.

Governments are among the largest, most complex organizations on earth — and almost none of it has been touched by modern AI. We're changing that, saving agencies tens, eventually hundreds, of billions a year and making the government one of the most efficient institutions in the world.

Looking to bring AI into your agency? Reach out to the team or book a demo [stratumindustries.co](https://stratumindustries.co/)

Contact: [founders@stratumindustries.co](mailto:founders@stratumindustries.co)

launches.title: Stratum Industries - clearing the entire U.S. Government backlog
launches.tagline: AI agents that review government applications end-to-end, so backlogs that took years clear in minutes.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Stratum builds AI agents that clear the U.S. government's backlog. A reviewer drops in an application, picks the rubric to check it against, and an agent plans, executes, and reviews the file end to end. Hundreds run in parallel with a human approving every decision, so a backlog that used to take months clears in the time it took to review one file.

**The Problem**

Every permit, license, patent, drug approval, grants and benefits claim in America has to be reviewed by a government adjudicator, on software built decades before AI. The result is millions of applications stuck in queues, and real people waiting months or years: veterans on disability ratings, families on pensions, builders on permits. The approval isn't the problem. The software it runs on is.

**How Stratum Works**

1. A reviewer drops in an application and selects the rubric it needs to be checked against.
2. An agent reads every page and checks the file against that rubric.
3. Every step routes to the model that reviews it most accurately for the least cost.
4. Anything missing goes back to the applicant as one specific request.
5. The officer gets the whole file summarized, with every citation behind it, and approves or denies it.

Hundreds of these run in parallel in the cloud, with full auditability at every step, and a person always makes the final call.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108348&key=user_uploads/1648613/15e81a7e-32ca-4280-9822-bc49caed3028)

**The Vision**

In a couple of years, dealing with the government should feel as frictionless as booking an Uber or paying with Apple Pay. You tell your Stratum agent what you need, a permit, a license, a claim, and it fills out the application and submits it. On the other side, the government's Stratum agents review it, ask your agent for anything missing, and settle it between themselves. The decision comes back the same day, in minutes. No waiting weeks or months. Clearing today's backlog is only the beginning.

**Team**

We're Vihaan and Raj, brothers. Vihaan was founding engineer #3 at Cadastral (acquired by Legora) and dropped out of Waterloo to build Stratum. Raj led GTM at Deel, averaging 220% of quota over two years and ranking top 5 of 1,000+ reps globally, and dropped out of grad school at Bath to build Stratum.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108348&key=user_uploads/1648613/40ac0440-bf77-46cf-b30e-370f734c3203)

**Our Ask**

* Do you work in government and struggle with a review backlog? We want to talk. Email [founders@stratumindustries.co](mailto:founders@stratumindustries.co)
* Know someone who runs adjudication at a federal, state, or local agency? Intro us.
